bundle.shortDescription: Find PTZ cameras and set their IP addresses
bundle.longDescription: Find the PTZ cameras on a network — including the ones on the wrong subnet — change their IP address, mask, gateway and DNS, and open their web interface. Panasonic (Easy IP), Sony (IP Setup), BirdDog (REST API), ONVIF cameras of any brand, PTZOptics/VHD discovery and any NDI camera.
